name: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel

breadcrumb.name: Green Roofs and Green Walls Systems

tagline: WALL PANEL FOR WALL MOUNTED LANDSCAPE GREENING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel is a panel that is mounted onto walls to hold planting pots to create a green wall. Panels are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), while fire-rated panels are manufactured from modified reinforced thermoplastics, and it has multiple points for pots to hook onto to create green walls of different spacings. SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 and SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2020 to create a green wall system.
metaDescription: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel mounts on walls to hold planting pots, with multiple hook points for varied spacings, and is used with VersiWall GP 2060 and 2020.
attributes: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
usage: Panels are used to create green walls on either internal or external wall facades.
